caseNameFull: SHANKER Et Al. v. RANKIN, CORPORATION COUNSEL OF THE CITY OF NEW YORK
attorneys: Ralph P. Katz for appellants., J. Lee Rankin, pro se, Frederic S. Nathan, and Stanley Buchsbaum for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed for want of a substantial federal question.

Mr. Justice Black and Mr. Justice Douglas are of the opinion that probable jurisdiction should be noted.
